_comment: Structured picker for txt2img: dropdowns whose keywords are fed to the LLM,
which writes the actual prompt. Data, not code - adding an option is an edit
here and needs no release, same as prompt_actions.json.
Each option carries `words`: the English phrasing that goes to the model.
`label` is what the dropdown shows and may be plainer or Norwegian-friendly;
the point of splitting them is that you pick the idea and the catalogue
`always` is prepended to every build - the quality/skin baseline that should
Nothing is preselected except where `default` says so. Age options are adult
always: extremely detailed realistic skin texture with visible pores, fine peach fuzz and natural blemishes
no plastic or airbrushed skin, no waxy sheen
natural subsurface scattering, realistic skin tone variation
sharp focus on the eyes, catchlights, individually visible eyelashes
photorealistic, shot on a full-frame camera
